CustomField.description: Read-only line margin for the TLE. Standard Margin is an Adjustment Type in the RCA line editor, so sellers would otherwise discount via Margin. This formula is display-only.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Margin), NULL, IF( AND(Margin > 0, Margin < 1), Margin, Margin / 100 ) )
CustomField.label: Margin
